description: This file defines the TextDumper class in the Twig profiling component, responsible for formatting profiling data into a text representation for debugging or analysis purposes.

classes.name: TextDumper
classes.description: A final class extending BaseDumper that formats profiling data for display as text.

methods.name: formatTemplate
methods.description: Formats a profile representing a template into a string with a specific prefix.

methods.name: formatNonTemplate
methods.description: Formats a profile representing non-template profiling data into a string with method details.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats profiling duration and percentage into a human-readable string.
